title: feat(spec): a greyed action says why — `disabledReason` beside `disabled`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBAQyBVaDQuUj1ZDR9GVydAG)_

Part of #26619 — the spec half. The console half (the greyed action's hover title and accessible description read the key) is the follow-up PR, which closes the card.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: #26790

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 动作元数据在 `disabled` 旁新增一个可选键 `disabledReason`：按钮置灰时说明原因的那句话（可翻译，字符串或内联多语言映射）。翻译位在 `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.disabledReason`，`translateAction` 会套用译文，`os i18n extract` 会生成这个键。空字符串和纯空白被拒绝。Studio 动作表单加了一行，四种语言的表单文案已补。
- **为什么改：** 裁决 A（6442737825）。现在置灰的按钮只能显示「对此记录不可用」，hotclm 的送审 / 发起签署 / 生效需要说清缺什么。这是规格的一半，控制台读取在下一个 PR。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加可选键，不写这个键的动作解析和显示都不变。它只用于展示：不参与服务端准入，lint 也不把它当判断条件读。控制台 PR 落地前没有渲染方读它（存活账本记为 planned，作者会收到 planned 提示）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（新键与空白拒绝），`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（`translateAction` 套用译文），`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`（生成翻译键）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-disabled-reason.test.ts`，预期 16 个用例全部通过，其中一条断言像 CEL 的字符串原样保留、不会被当成表达式。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`ActionSchema.disabledReason`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`), an optional key beside `disabled`. It is the sentence a greyed action shows to say why it is unavailable. An action that does not declare it parses exactly as before.

- **The name.** `disabledReason`, the card's candidate, kept for three reasons. It pairs with the key it explains (`disabled` → `disabledReason`), the way an author reads the two together. It names the content (why), not one place it lands: the console shows it as a button's hover title, as its accessible description, and as a menu item's second line, so `disabledTooltip` would name one of three. And it is the console's own word already (`useDisabledReason`, `disabledReasonFor`, `DisabledReason` in `renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx`), so spec and renderer speak one vocabulary. Rejected: `disabledMessage` (reads as the `successMessage` / `errorMessage` family, copy shown after a run), `disabledTooltip`, `disabledHint`. All four, with `disabledText`, are renamed onto the key, on the action and in a translation bundle.
- **The shape.** An I18nLabel: `z.union([z.string().refine(NON_BLANK_STRING), InlineLocaleMapSchema])`. The string arm refuses `''` and whitespace-only, with a message that names the default it would replace and says to omit the key instead. The refinement is the shared `NON_BLANK_STRING`, which `refinement-projection.ts` declares, so the published `json-schema/ui/Action.json` carries it (`minLength: 1`, `pattern: "\\S"`) and the dropped-refinement ledger gains no row. A first cut with a `superRefine` added 12 ledger rows; this one adds none. The map arm is `InlineLocaleMapSchema` unchanged, the I18nLabel every other copy key takes.
- **Display only.** It never enters server admission: nothing in the runtime reads it, and a disabled action that is called anyway is refused by its own rules (its body or hook, `requiredPermissions`). It is not an expression: a predicate-looking value comes out of the parse as the same string, where `disabled` is lowered to its CEL envelope. `os validate` reads `disabled` and not `disabledReason`, and the lint's literal-member census (`validate-expressions.test.ts`, receiver `action`) stays `['disabled', 'name', 'objectName', 'visible']`.
- **Translation slot.** `actionTranslationSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`) declares `disabledReason` at both addresses, `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION` and `globalActions.ACTION`, beside `confirmText` / `successMessage`. `translateAction` (`i18n-resolver.ts`) overlays it the way it overlays `description`: the bundle's sentence for the locale chain, else the authored value. The address lists in both files' docblocks name it.
- **Extract.** `collectExpectedEntries` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) emits the key for a top-level object action, a global action and an action declared inline on an object. It is `pushOptional`, like `description`: an action that gives no reason seeds nothing and is not a coverage gap, because the console has its own default sentence.
- **Studio.** `action.form.ts` gains a `disabledReason` row under `disabled` in the Placement section (the plain row `errorMessage` uses, same I18nLabel node). The four `metadata-forms` bundles in `@objectstack/platform-objects` carry its label and help (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES).
- **Liveness.** `liveness/action.json` row `disabledReason`: `planned` with `authorWarn` and an `authorHint`, so `os validate` warns an author who declares it that nothing shows it yet. The framework read points are the evidence, and the four console readers are named as the follow-up that flips it to `live` and drops the warning.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` gains the key in the interface block and a "Saying why: `disabledReason`" section; `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` names disabled reasons on the `_actions` row.
- **Generated.** `authorable-surface/ui.json` (`ui/Action:disabledReason`), `liveness/state-counts/action.md`, and four `content/docs/references/**` pages, by `check:generated --fix`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/26619-action-disabled-reason.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` at `minor` (AGENTS.md step 3: a kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves). `@objectstack/lint` changes a comment and a test only, so it publishes nothing.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-disabled-reason.test.ts` (16): the parse (string, locale map, optional), the not-a-condition pin, the I18nLabel refusals shared with `label`, the blank refusal (`''`, whitespace: path and message), the four near-miss renames, the inline action still refusing the key, the translation slot at both addresses, the bundle-side rename, and `translateAction` (translated, global address, fallback to authored, no key added).
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-action-disabled-reason.test.ts`: the three emit sites, nothing seeded for an action without a reason, the declared text carried into the bundle and gated until translated, and one fixture through schema → extract → translation schema.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: a bare-field source that is an error on `disabled` produces no finding on `disabledReason`.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`: the shipped ledger warns on `disabledReason` at the action, with the row's hint; an action without it draws nothing. Two pins move with the new key: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (the metadata-form catalog, 688 → 689 after the `main` merge; main's ADR-0142 `queue` / `assignment_rule` rows had moved it 686 → 688) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (the action key set, 47 → 48, with `disabledReason` added to the named sample).

## Acceptance notes

- **The renderer half follows.** Between this landing and the console PR an author can declare the key and nothing renders it; the liveness row is `planned` and the author-warning lint says so. The docs section says the console does not show the key yet, names the default reason every greyed action shows until the readers ship, and says `os validate` warns an author who declares it. Direction of the window: spec accepts ahead of the renderer, never the reverse.
- **Skills-docs is owed, not done here.** `skills/**` is Tier H. Putting the skills lines in this PR would make the spec half wait for a maintainer approval; the owed files are listed on the `Skills-docs:` line for the seat to file. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` and its eval file are at 0 token headroom, so that card pays under the ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」.
- **A blank value inside an inline locale map is not refused.** The map arm is `InlineLocaleMapSchema` as every I18nLabel takes it; refusing a blank map value would need a refinement the projection's closed list cannot publish, or a second locale-map schema. The ruling names the empty string, which is refused.
